He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball|Mississippi State Bulldogs]]. ==Early life and high school== Peters was born in [[New Orleans, Louisiana]] and grew up in the city's [[9th Ward of New Orleans|9th Ward]] in a single parent household as his father was incarcerated for most of his childhood.{{cite web|url=https://www.clarionledger.com/story/sports/college/mississippi-state/2017/02/15/amidst-tragedy-lamar-peters-pushes/97918912/|title=Lamar Peters pushes on amidst tragedy|first=Will|last=Sammon|work=The Clarion Ledger|date=February 15, 2017|access-date=January 13, 2020}} He attended [[Landry-Walker College and Career Preparatory High School]], where he helped lead the Charging Buccaneers to back-to-back state championships in his sophomore and junior seasons. He averaged 19.7 points and was named first team All-Metro by ''[[The Times-Picayune/The New Orleans Advocate|The New Orleans Advocate]]'' during his junior season. Peters committed to [[Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball|Mississippi State]] over offers from [[LSU Tigers men's basketball|LSU]], [[Baylor Bears basketball|Baylor]]. [[South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball|South Carolina]], [[Memphis Tigers men's basketball|Memphis]], [[Texas Longhorns men's basketball|Texas]], [[Miami Hurricanes men's basketball|Miami (Fla.)]] and [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois]] going into his senior year. He said he developed a relationship with Bulldogs assistant coach [[Korey McCray]].{{cite web|url=https://www.nola.com/sports/high_schools/article_eb74fd7f-0928-5798-9e71-cd5ea98c5e8c.html|title=Landry-Walker basketball player Lamar Peters commits to Mississippi State|first=Rod|last=Walker|work=[[The Times-Picayune/The New Orleans Advocate|The New Orleans Advocate]]|date=June 27, 2015|access-date=January 13, 2020}} As a senior, Peters averaged 26 points and five assists and was named first team 5A All-State by the LSWA and was named the Outstanding Player of the Year for the New Orleans Metro Area by ''The Advocate''.{{cite web|url=https://foxsports1340am.com/lamar-peters-learning-leadership-young-age/|title=Lamar Peters is learning leadership at a young age|first=Joshua|last=Vinson|website=[[KCBL|FoxSports1340AM.com]]|date=February 7, 2017|access-date=January 13, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://www.nola.com/sports/high_schools/article_a12c42b7-333c-57a8-a439-9084029a34d0.html|title=New Orleans area All-Metro Boys Basketball team: Landry-Walker's Lamar Peters named Outstanding Player; Karr's Taurus Howard selected Coach of the Year|work=New Orleans Advocate|date=April 26, 2016|access-date=January 13, 2020}} ==College career== As a true freshman, Peters averaged 10.7 points and 3.4 assists per game and was named to the [[Southeastern Conference]] (SEC) All-Freshman team.{{cite web|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/msus-quinndary-weatherspoon-lamar-peters-earn-all-sec-honors/|title=MSU's Quinndary Weatherspoon, Lamar Peters Earn All-SEC honors|first=Paul|last=Jones|website=[[CBS Sports]]|date=March 7, 2017|access-date=January 13, 2020}} He averaged 9.6 points and 4.5 assists in his sophomore season and was named the SEC co-Player of the Week on February 26, 2018, after averaging 17 points, 5.5 rebounds, six assists and 2.5 steals in wins over [[Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball|Texas A&M]] and [[South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball|South Carolina]].{{cite web|url=https://www.nola.com/sports/pelicans/article_f3f625f1-b085-5bb3-9be4-f222447eb0dc.html|title=Former Landry-Walker guard Lamar Peters declares for 2018 NBA Draft, will not hire agent|first=William|last=Guillory|website=NOLA.com|date=April 4, 2018|access-date=January 13, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://www.djournal.com/sports/peters-picked-sec-co-player-of-the-week/article_dd074005-41a3-5b33-9f0f-77581ddc3394.html|title=Peters picked SEC Co-Player of the Week|first=Logan|last=Lowery|work=Northeast Mississippi Daily Journal|date=February 26, 2018|access-date=January 13, 2020}} He declared for the [[2018 NBA draft]], but ultimately decided to return for his junior year.{{cite web|url=https://www.djournal.com/announcements_announcements/peters-declares-for-nba-draft-won-t-hire-agent/article_c0cb36c4-6ad5-58d9-abf8-1f0f6fd059cb.html|title=Peters declares for NBA Draft, won't hire agent|first=Logan|last=Lowery|work=Northeast Mississippi Daily Journal|date=April 4, 2018|access-date=January 13, 2020}} As a junior, Peters averaged 11.9 points, 5.2 assists and 1.7 steals per game.{{cite web|url=http://www.reflector-online.com/sports/article_e1d2a910-5637-11e9-8ee3-9bcdceda0f27.html|title=Column: Peters should stay another year to improve|first=Renaldo|last=Hopkins|work=The Reflector|date=April 3, 2019|access-date=January 13, 2020|archive-date=December 28, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211228135902/http://www.reflector-online.com/sports/article_e1d2a910-5637-11e9-8ee3-9bcdceda0f27.html|url-status=dead}} Peters was named the SEC co-Player of the Week a second time on December 10, 2018, after he averaged 27.5 points, five assists and eight 3-pointers made per game in performances against [[Clemson Tigers men's basketball|Clemson]] and [[McNeese State Cowboys basketball|McNeese State]].{{cite web|url=https://www.clarionledger.com/story/sports/college/mississippi-state/2018/12/10/lamar-peters-mississippi-state-bulldogs-ben-howland-ncaa-basketball-rankings-cincinatti-msu/2269995002/|title=Lamar Peters' brilliant performances is key to Mississippi State's success this season|first=Tyler|last=Horka|work=Clarion-Ledger|date=December 10, 2018|access-date=January 13, 2020}} Following the end of the season he again entered the NBA Draft and hired an agent, forgoing his final season of eligibility.{{cite web|url=https://newsms.fm/lamar-peters-hires-agent-enters-nba-draft/|title=Lamar Peters hires agent, enters NBA Draft|first=Steven|last=Gagliano|website=NewsMS.fm|date=April 22, 2019|access-date=January 13, 2020|archive-date=June 7, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190607151512/https://newsms.fm/lamar-peters-hires-agent-enters-nba-draft/|url-status=dead}} ==Professional career== After going undrafted in the [[2019 NBA draft]], Peters joined the [[New York Knicks]]' summer league roster.{{cite web|url=https://www.sny.tv/knicks/news/names-to-watch-on-knicks-summer-league-roster/308734044|title=Names to watch on Knicks' Summer League roster|first=Phil|last=Akre|website=SNY.tv|date=July 4, 2019|access-date=January 13, 2020}} Peters signed an [[Exhibit 10]] contract with the Knicks on August 11, 2019.{{cite web|url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2849326-knicks-rumors-undrafted-g-lamar-peters-agrees-to-non-guaranteed-contract|title=Knicks Rumors: Undrafted G Lamar Peters Agrees to Non-Guaranteed Contract|first=Joseph|last=Zucker|website=Bleacher Report|date=August 12, 2019|access-date=January 13, 2020}} Peters was waived by the Knicks on October 19, 2019, and joined the team's [[NBA G League]] affiliate, the [[Westchester Knicks]].{{cite web|url=https://www.sny.tv/knicks/news/knicks-waive-guard-lamar-peters-forwards-vj-king-and-kenny-wooten/311223220/|title=Knicks waive guard Lamar Peters, forwards VJ King and Kenny Wooten|first=Corey|last=Hersch|website=SNY.tv|date=October 19, 2019|access-date=January 13, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://www.ridiculousupside.com/2020/1/3/21037424/lamar-peters-former-mississippi-state-bulldogs-journey-to-nba-leads-him-to-new-york|title=Lamar Peters: Former Mississippi State Bulldog's Journey To NBA Leads Him To New York|first=Chris|last=Priczak|website=RidiculousUpside.com|publisher=SB Nation|date=January 3, 2020|access-date=January 13, 2020}} On February 26, 2020, Peters set a new Westchester record with 19 assists to go with 19 points in a 129–115 win over the [[Greensboro Swarm]].{{cite web |title=Peters Sets Assist Record As Knicks Stop Swarm |url=https://gleague.nba.com/games/20200226/gbowes/ |website=NBA.com |access-date=February 27, 2020 |date=February 26, 2020}} During the shortened 2019–20 season, Peters averaged 17.8 points, 7.3 assists, 2.8 rebounds, and 1.4 steals per game, shooting 42% from the field and 40% from three point range.{{cite web |last1=Schmidt |first1=Dakota |title=Let's Appreciate Some G Leaguers: Edition #4 |url=https://www.ridiculousupside.com/2020/4/16/21222844/lets-appreciate-some-g-leaguers-edition-4-ennis-peters-hall-reaves |website=Ridiculous Upside |publisher=[[SB Nation]] |access-date=May 3, 2020 |date=April 16, 2020}} On December 6, 2020, he signed with [[Bursaspor Basketbol|Frutti Extra Bursaspor]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi|Turkish Super League]] (BSL).{{Cite web|url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Turkey/news/656883/Bursaspor-tabs-Lamar-Peters|title=Bursaspor tabs Lamar Peters|date=December 6, 2020|publisher=Eurobasket|language=En|access-date=December 7, 2020}} On November 2, 2021, he signed with [[Saski Baskonia|Baskonia]] of the Spanish [[Liga ACB]] and the [[EuroLeague]].{{Cite web|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/baskonia-announces-lamar-peters/|title=Baskonia announces Lamar Peters|last=|first=|date=November 2, 2021|website=|publisher=Sportando|language=En|access-date=November 3, 2021}} On February 10, 2022, Peters parted ways with the team.{{Cite web|url=https://www.baskonia.com/saski-baskonia-y-lamar-peters-acuerdan-finalizar-su-vinculacion/|title=Saski Baskonia y Lamar Peters acuerdan finalizar su vinculación|last=|first=|date=February 10, 2022|website=baskonia.com|publisher=|language=es|access-date=February 10, 2022}} On April 19, 2022, he signed with [[Baloncesto Fuenlabrada|Fuenlabrada]] of the Spanish [[Liga ACB]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Spain/news/741366/Fuenlabrada-inks-Lamar-Peters|title=Fuenlabrada inks Lamar Peters|last=|first=|date=April 19, 2022|website=|publisher=Eurobasket|language=En|access-date=April 20, 2022}} On January 13, 2023, he signed with [[ASK Karditsas B.C.|Karditsa]] of the [[Greek Basket League]].{{Cite web|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/ask-karditsas-inks-lamar-peters/|title=ASK Karditsas inks Lamar Peters|last=|first=|date=January 13, 2023|website=|publisher=Sportando|language=En|access-date=January 13, 2023}} In 5 league games, he averaged 5 points and 1.6 assists in 18 minutes per contest, before suffering a season-ending injury. ==Personal life== Peters' best friend is Tyree Griffin, the point guard for [[Southern Miss Golden Eagles basketball|Southern Miss]]. Peters' father, Walter Sterling, was killed in a shooting in New Orleans during his freshman season at Mississippi State.{{cite web|url=https://sports.usatoday.com/2017/12/22/in-tough-times-why-does-mississippi-states-lamar-peters-lean-on-usms-tyree-griffin/|title=In tough times, why does Mississippi State's Lamar Peters lean on USM's Tyree Griffin?|first=Will|last=Sammon|website=[[USA Today]]|date=December 22, 2017|access-date=January 13, 2020|archive-date=September 23, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210923071624/https://sports.usatoday.com/2017/12/22/in-tough-times-why-does-mississippi-states-lamar-peters-lean-on-usms-tyree-griffin/|url-status=dead}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://www.proballers.com/basketball/player/178666/peters-lamar Lamar Peters] at Proballers *[https://gleague.nba.com/player/lamar-peters/ NBA G League profile] *[https://hailstate.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/lamar-peters/4940 Mississippi State Bulldogs bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Peters, Lamar}} [[Category:1998 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American expatriate basketball people in Greece]] [[Category:American expatriate basketball people in Spain]] [[Category:American expatriate basketball people in Turkey]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:ASK Karditsas B.C. players]] [[Category:Baloncesto Fuenlabrada players]] [[Category:Basketball players from New Orleans]] [[Category:Bursaspor Basketbol players]] [[Category:Liga ACB players]] [[Category:Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball players]] [[Category:Point guards]] [[Category:Saski Baskonia players]] [[Category:Westchester Knicks players]] [[Category:21st-century American sportsmen]]
